intro: Before a site gets built, I prototype it as one working page. These are the ones worth keeping: open any of them, try it at phone size, and scroll.

items.title: One Take
items.description: A keynote film scrubbed by scroll, with no cuts: the wordmark squeezes into its period, an iris opens onto the work grid, liquid glass relights a case study, a lock screen becomes a phone and a Mac, and the contact card hangs on a wall before the take loops.

items.title: Abbrivio
items.description: Ten shader-painted covers ride a WebGL gallery you drag and fling like boats on the lagoon: a bow wave runs back along each one before it rocks to rest, titles rise out of a waterline, and each case study ends at a vaporetto stop where the next cover docks from the right.

items.title: Lumen
items.description: Seven landscapes drawn live by shaders (sea fog, a dune at dusk, a low sun on the Atlantic, rain on a night vaporetto window) replace each other through a liquid, noise-edged wipe while titles rise letter by letter and a timecode rolls. The index turns each series into a preview that trails the cursor.

items.title: Lungatavola
items.description: The cursor leaves a trail of project cards behind a line-masked headline. The work list floats a tilting preview, services flip past on a split-flap departures board as you scroll, client names can be thrown, and opening a project wipes into a case study in its own colours.

items.title: Casa Ocra
items.description: A Venetian study opens from a thin slit behind the title, then the page walks through it: images wipe in, scrolling runs one day as the canal's reflection ripples across the ceiling until a pendant takes over at night, materials slide past on a pinned wall, and the floor plan draws itself.

items.title: Zampillo
items.description: A soda can drawn in WebGL, beaded with condensation, floats between the words of the headline, tilts toward your pointer and spins with scroll speed. Each flavour bursts a new colour out of the can and pours a new label up its side, then a crate fills with springy lids and a dot-matrix Italy lights up the stockists.

items.title: Pulse
items.description: Contour lines behind a giant PULSE breathe until you press Play; then a synth loop made in the browser starts and every kick sends a shockwave through them. Headliners stretch under the cursor, a gooey blob slides the timetable between days and a ferry route draws itself on the map.

items.title: Casotto
items.description: Service stickers tumble into the hero under hand-written physics you can grab and throw, the page melts into a new colour every section, case cards tilt in 3D, process cards stack as you scroll and the wordmark steps out of your cursor's way.

items.title: Ai Tre Remi
items.description: A bàcaro in Cannaregio: the name rises out of a canal whose WebGL water mirrors the hand-drawn skyline and ripples under your cursor. The bar draws itself in ink, the cicchetti counter drags with inertia, and an open-now badge runs on Venice time.

items.title: Tacca
items.description: A live revenue dashboard leans back under the headline, ticking its KPIs and streaming its chart, then lands flat as you scroll. A pinned demo wires data sources into a hub, grows a chart and shares a report while a ghost cursor clicks through.

items.title: Field
items.description: Ten thousand points behind the page morph from a data grid into one shape per project, then skill clusters, a helix timeline and an @ for contact.

items.title: Signal
items.description: A single request travels one amber route down the page: it draws a glyph for each project, splits into four skill lanes, merges into a git-graph career timeline and ends at the contact box as a 200 OK.

items.title: The Stack
items.description: A pinned 3D stack of four slabs (Interface, API, Queue, Database) reconfigures itself for every section: each project's real architecture, a skill grid, a career staircase, and finally a contact card, over colour-blocked backgrounds.
